headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to give more attention to research on women's health.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President Biden, focuses on research and new ideas in women's health. Based on its title, it directs federal agencies to expand or strengthen their work studying health issues that affect women. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, deadlines, and funding details are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Federal health research may give more attention to conditions and health needs that affect them.
They are directed by the order to advance research and innovation on women's health.
Federal research priorities in their field may shift toward women's health topics.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 18, 2024; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
